aboutText: Located in Thornbury, Total Rendering has been a trusted family business for over 15 years. Our expertise in rendering and solid plastering has earned us a reputation for quality workmanship, professional service, and timely project completion. We specialise in transforming existing homes throughout Melbourne with high-quality makeovers, delivering results on time and within budget, all with a personal touch.
servicesText: We offer a comprehensive range of rendering services, including cement and acrylic rendering, solid plastering, and home renovations. With 15 years of experience, we ensure high-quality finishes for both internal and external projects in Thornbury and across Melbourne.

services.title: Cement Rendering
services.desc: Our cement rendering service delivers durable and weather-resistant wall finishes, perfect for withstanding Melbourne's climate.

services.title: Acrylic Rendering
services.desc: Flexible acrylic render solutions suitable for various substrates and climates, providing a modern and sleek appearance.

services.title: Solid Plastering
services.desc: Expert internal plastering for smooth, even surfaces in homes and buildings, ensuring a flawless finish.

services.title: Home Makeovers
services.desc: Complete home exterior renovations to refresh and enhance your property's appearance, adding value and curb appeal.

services.title: Wall Preparation
services.desc: Thorough surface preparation to ensure optimal adhesion and long-lasting results for all rendering projects.

services.title: Custom Finishes
services.desc: Specialised texturing and colour options to match your design preferences, creating unique and personalised walls.
